title: Cheryl Engine Graphics Manifest Index 1.0
description: A graphics-manifests.json index selects registered graphics-definition documents for automatic loading.
$comment: References resolve relative to the index and must identify exact registered files. Repeated references are loaded once. Runtime loading does not open this schema or unreferenced JSON files.

$schema.description: Optional schema identifier for editor validation; the runtime does not resolve it.

items.description: Forward-slash JSON path relative to this index. The target must be a registered graphics-definition document, not another index.
